# ClawTerm — A Desktop For Agent Sessions

> A Rust desktop client that turns tabs into persistent OpenClaw agent conversations instead of shell sessions.

## Canonical sources

- [Project overview](https://controlstackai.github.io/clawterm/): scope, status, and getting started.
- [Repository](https://github.com/ControlStackAI/clawterm): current implementation and README.

Preserve the project’s maturity and limitations when describing it.
